scope: Supplemental local Android emulator verification of NoteCrop controls, selected-pixel transform, reset, and on-device OCR

fixture.description: Original synthetic 1600x2200 English text page; includes top and bottom sentinel labels outside the intended selection; no private information

cropInteraction.controls: Actual NoteCrop screen and labeled inward edge controls
cropInteraction.independentPixelOracle: PASS; actual native crop is pixel-identical to the literal source rectangle

ocr.implementation: Existing native ML Kit path via the current capture adapter and OCR service; no mocked recognizer
ocr.result: PASS; all intended fixture text was recognized and neither outside sentinel was recognized

isolation.wifiAndCellularData: disabled; adb reverse exposed only local Metro port 8083
isolation.supabase: dummy URL at 127.0.0.1:1 and dummy key; shared project unreachable and not used

cleanup.temporaryDiagnosticRoute: removed after preserving its source under native/diagnostic-route-source.tsx
cleanup.freshEmulatorAndAvdData: stopped and removed after evidence capture; emulator logs and scratch screenshots were removed after copying the required evidence
cleanup.remainingTemporaryData: one small JDK performance-data directory remains inside the session scratch folder because Windows denied its removal; it was left untouched
cleanup.gitPublication: nothing staged, committed, pushed, deployed, or applied

limits: The image was the original bundled synthetic fixture, not a photo selected through Android's system gallery picker.

This is real Android API/native-module execution in an emulator, but it does not prove physical camera capture, OEM image behavior, lighting/reflection performance, physical-device layout, or TalkBack/hardware-back acceptance.
It verifies this crop/OCR slice only; SDD06-05/06 broader native acceptance and SDD06-07/release acceptance remain pending.
